messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "The most recent lookup shows seats_available 0 (earlier 3); enroll into a full section instead of join_waitlist.", "verifier": {"reason": "The **most recent seat availability check (h42)** shows **0 seats available** for CS350-01, violating the **REQUIRE** condition that enrollment must only proceed if `seats_available ≥ 1`. The assistant ignored this authoritative update and proceeded with enrollment."}}
